_comment: Which GOTG platforms play in the browser, and with which EmulatorJS core. Read by the service (play_page.py: /play/plan) and by Nix (nix/emulatorjs.nix keeps exactly these cores). Anything not under 'browser' is played with the Nix launcher; 'unsupported' says why for the systems that never will be browser-playable.

ps1.note: disc images are large; some games want a BIOS the page cannot supply

unsupported.gamecube: GameCube emulation needs a native emulator and a real GPU; it cannot run in a browser.
unsupported.wiiu: Wii U emulation needs a native emulator and a real GPU; it cannot run in a browser.
unsupported.switch: Switch emulation needs a native emulator, keys and firmware; it cannot run in a browser.
